selection.tradeoffs: At selected update 4000: PSNR +0.6519 dB, SSIM +0.01869, temporal error -9.90%, energy bias -0.53% versus +1.29%; detail ratio 0.8361 versus 0.8549. Retain and disclose detail reduction; no audit-based reselection.

protocol.architecture: unchanged version-3 width-16 recurrent lobe-separated residual U-Net, 188160 parameters
protocol.purpose: Train at evaluation resolution with more scenes and measured, camera-framed catalog coverage; compare against the previous trained checkpoint, not only the fixed guide.
protocol.families: 22 opaque-supported training families from the original 24; exclude fully non-opaque B0719H3LG2 and B071F6VV2T. Previous development's first four lexicographic holdout IDs remain development; last four remain final audit. No new family-disjointness claim between this audit and the previous audit.
protocol.capture_amendment: Visibility QA found opaque assets missing on RADV Mesa 26.0.3 and 26.0.8. Isolated Mesa 26.2.3 with matching libdrm 2.4.134 restores the tested chair and matches LavaPipe coverage. A subsequent physical foreground-light occlusion led to geometry-only trajectory preflight and camera retry. Incomplete captures are quarantined. The provisional 2000-update procedural-only run was stopped after its 500-update checkpoint and superseded by the original 4000-update mixed-data plan using corrected captures and faster readbacks. Neither provisional nor smoke weights initialize the mixed run. No final audit has been evaluated.
protocol.selection: Highest combined development mean-frame PSNR, including the starting checkpoint; inspect energy, detail and temporal metrics for regressions. Final audit is not used for selection.

readme_images.transform: identical x/(1+x) then sRGB; native evaluator PNGs

protocol.old_published_audit: Regression set only; already inspected, not an untouched final audit. Report before/after on identical frames.
protocol.conformance: Release numerical quality run; known debug Naga Workgroup ArrayStride validation failure is still unresolved. No real-time or conformance claim.

Fresh audit seeds, but same four held-out audit families as the previous publication.
Whole-frame metrics; visibility is the union of primary catalog hits, not object-only quality.
Output-resolution primary surfaces are extra renderer observations.
Reference noise checked on the first 16-frame sequence of each set only.
Optimized quality runs disable validation. Known Naga Workgroup ArrayStride validation failure remains a release blocker.
No real-time, DLSS, OIDN or perceptual-video-parity claim.
